articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science and mathematics benchmarks, narrowing the gap with domain-specific expert systems. Enterprise API pricing has been restructured around a new tiered compute-unit model.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini Ultra 2, which tops SWE-Bench Verified and the new HumanEval-Agent benchmark with scores exceeding 75% on fully autonomous multi-file code generation and debugging tasks. The model integrates a built-in tool-use layer that allows it to invoke compilers, test suites, and shell commands within its reasoning loop. Google simultaneously announced deep integration across Vertex AI and Android Studio.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration Framework for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic announced a new orchestration framework that allows Claude models to autonomously compose and manage multi-step tool-use pipelines across enterprise systems including databases, APIs, and internal knowledge bases. The framework includes built-in guardrails for human-in-the-loop approval at configurable risk thresholds. Early adopters report 40-60% reduction in time spent on complex back-office workflows.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots have entered limited production deployment at two Gigafactory locations, performing bin-picking, component inspection, and inter-station material transport. The Gen 3 units feature redesigned actuators with 30% higher torque density and an overhauled vision-language-action model for more robust manipulation in unstructured environments. Tesla plans to expand deployment to logistics partners by Q1 2027.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction Sites
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, backed by Hyundai, revealed the commercial version of its electric Atlas humanoid robot tailored for construction and heavy industrial use, featuring IP67 ruggedization and a 90-minute hot-swappable battery system. The robot can carry payloads up to 35 kg while navigating uneven terrain and climbing ladders. Pilot programs with three major construction firms are scheduled across the US and South Korea.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors has entered risk production, targeting high-performance AI accelerator and data-center CPU customers. The node promises an 18% speed improvement and 25% power reduction over N2, with backside power delivery as a standard feature. Volume production is expected in the second half of 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Trial
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to begin human clinical trials of its N2 implant, which doubles the electrode count to 2,048 channels and features a wireless data throughput of 200 Mbps, enabling higher-resolution neural decoding. The trial will focus on patients with cervical spinal cord injuries, aiming to restore both cursor control and limited robotic arm manipulation. The approval follows 18 months of promising safety data from the first-generation cohort.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at an $18 billion valuation, led by Microsoft and joined by NVIDIA and Bezos Expeditions, to build its first dedicated humanoid robot factory in South Carolina. The company's Figure 03 robot integrates a vision-language-action model co-developed with OpenAI for generalized warehouse and logistics tasks. Figure aims to produce 10,000 units annually by 2028.
